name: aphrody
description: Pure-Rust single-MCP-server automation surface for Claude Code. ONE native binary `aphrody-mcp` (~7 MB, sub-millisecond cold-start) exposes 20 tools across 6 capability groups — 8 ex-google_mcp (coding_style_guide, universal_web_fetch, dns_recon, auth_extract, chrome_autopsy, advanced_recon, native_hooks, start_dashboard) + 2 voice (voice_synthesize, voice_transcribe) + 2 Context7 (context7_resolve_library_id, context7_query_docs, native Rust port of the upstream Bun bridge) + 3 Microsoft Learn (microsoft_docs_search, microsoft_docs_fetch, microsoft_code_sample_search — native Rust HTTP MCP proxy onto learn.microsoft.com/api/mcp) + 3 reverse-engineering (re_triage PE/ELF triage, re_strings ASCII/UTF-16LE extraction, re_sections entropy map — via aphrody-re) + 2 aggregators (docs_auto_search parallel docs fanout, aphrody_mcp_call MCP proxy). Zero JS runtime, zero subprocess relay, zero secondary MCP server. 2 slash commands (/status, /docs). 21 agents, 34 skills. Cross-platform: Linux #1, Windows #2, WASM #3.
